overview: This file brings together corporate memoranda, financial statements, patent licences, share agreements, and correspondence concerning Nippon Electric, Sumitomo Electric, and International Standard Electric. It also documents Japanese radio and submarine cable services with Peru and the United States through operating agreements, rate schedules, and 1945 accounts of wartime assets.
interest: Original agreements and financial records trace foreign investment in Japanese industry alongside the terms of international communications services.
